title: Stopped product-ring interchange and rational centers for conditional kappa = 7.79476e-5
body:
This extends my merged [PR #36](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/36) at `11817ccacb564bb7f98789c20dc11d3fece207e3`, with one new commit on upstream `main` at `56b66d58297deca1d7dd130247d720e960f77a37`. The #10 → #18 → #24 → #32 → #36 proof lineage and attributed two-stage, ordinary-leaf and semantic/bulk interfaces are retained.

Under the retained multiplication framework and those analytic/tape interfaces,

$$
T(n)=O\!\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{194869}{2500000000}=7.79476\times10^{-5}.
$$

## Construction

The bit network uses `(23,23)`. A common generic rational basis and opposite bank orders reduce each rank-`r` projector residual to one contiguous reversed rank-`r` child. The full involution factorization includes the complementary diagonal blocks and uses physically lower triangular adapters.

The address arithmetic acts componentwise on fixed-width atoms. Each adapter is paid as an atom loop, costing `O(V e/w)`. Stopping at `w=ceil(e^(1/1000))` uses the retained ordinary interchange at leaves and peeled remainders. A constant-size outer wrapper restores ordinary interchange; its conversion factor does not enter the recursive moment.

The complex network uses `(24,24)` with aligned pair-star orders and all 24 disjoint centers. Their total is decoded by exact division by 21. A common grid `2^(-P) * 21^(-K)`, with `K=G(D+1)`, covers the active recursion chain. Completed children preserve the incoming odd-denominator exponent; the completed outer transform restores dyadic encoding. No child return is rounded.

The coarse bit saving is `4019/50000000`, giving the ordinary bit saving `803380799/10000000000000` after stopping. The strict complex saving is `1949/25000000`. Their coarse-bit and complex moment gaps exceed `4.2909639537e-10` and `1.3338373969e-10`, respectively.

The assembly retains **Zhihao Chen (jacklightChen)**'s PR #23 composition of **RaD (hipotures)**'s semantic precision, routing, phase-cell inverse and bulk resampling. The rational-center charge preserves `C1=1`; the three nested row reserves are bounded by `p^4000`. The assembly bit parameter is weakened to `0.00007795982204` to leave strict room below the stopped complex leaf saving. All 47 strict constraints and seven assembly margins hold, with final absorption gap greater than `6.6129e-11`.

| [#18](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/18) | Partial-swap frames and removal of the source rank penalty; binary retained totals, compatible carrier reuse and positive frames; selected `(25,23,57)` basis. | `1.884586e-6` |
| [#24](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/24) | Complementary auxiliary endpoint gauges, selected `(32,30,40)` basis, general nondegenerate binary phase residuals and updated precision guard. | `5.98615e-6` |

Baker–Harman–Pintz supplies the prime-interval theorem used by the adopted packing argument. Historical AI-assistance disclosures are preserved. The table records construction dependencies and contribution scope; independently published exponent savings are not added together.

## Proof and attribution

- `notes/stopped-product-note.tex`: selected construction and assembly, supplied as LaTeX source.
- `scripts/stopped_product_producer.py`: new rational-center producer reconstruction and reuse checks for the bit input.
- `certificates/stopped-product-network.json`: recursive moments, stopped savings, semantic precision, product row stock and assembly.
- `references/copied-centers/` and `references/semantic-bulk/`: retained pinned proof sources, original notices and licenses.

The result remains conditional on the retained analytic/tape interfaces, constructive setup and eventual thresholds. Finite checks do not formally verify the complete theorem. The inherited `patches/batched-23.patch` remains the #10 baseline; this extension is presented in its standalone proof.

The new opposite-bank factorization, stopped product-ring interface, aligned rational-center construction and integration are contributed by **icekylinx**, with substantial OpenAI GPT-6 Astra and Codex assistance. Source pins and inherited attribution remain in `SOURCES.json` and `NOTICE`. The repository retains Apache-2.0; imported RaD sources retain CC0. The upstream community results and review records are preserved. Exploratory variants, duplicate snapshots and large raw graph dumps are excluded.

## Validation

- Matched the unchanged h23 bit producer counts and histogram to the previously verified copied-center input.
- Rebuilt the new h24 all-disjoint complex producer with aligned pair-star orders; exact rational scatter coefficients, supports, binary frames, all 8,966 matches and every histogram entry passed.
- Reconstructed both child lists and certified their strict moments, stopped ordinary-bit saving and subordinate atom-adapter toll.
- Checked the rational-center scalar charge, semantic induction, three-factor product row reserve, 47 strict constraints and seven assembly margins with exact arithmetic.
- Refreshed the inherited joint-dual source manifest after the Makefile, README and NOTICE changes; regenerated its dependent certificate and validation receipt, and replayed the affected `verify-joint` group.
- Checked the final source diff for whitespace errors. Proof sources are included; no PDF compilation was performed this round.

Other unchanged previous-round producer and regression checks were not rerun.
